description: Documentation only - not loaded or validated at runtime (records are written with validate:false). Full response to a SonaSky form, written to the user's repo for `atproto-record` destinations. A form may use a different collection NSID via `destination.collection`.

answers.description: Object of fieldId -> string | string[], limited to fields on the visited section path.

visitedSections.description: Ordered ids of the sections the user actually saw.
